description: An abstract class for processing leave-related emails within the OrangeHRM system, including methods for retrieving subscribers, employees with specific roles, supervisors, leave details, and comments.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveEmailProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods for handling leave email notifications, including subscriber retrieval, employee role filtering, leave details, and comments.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LeaveRequestCommentService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getSubscribersForEvent
methods.description: Retrieves email subscribers for a specific notification event ID.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Gets employees with a specific role related to a given employee.

methods.name: getSelf
methods.description: Returns the recipient information for the given employee.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Gets recipients subscribed to specific leave email notifications based on email name.

methods.name: getSupervisors
methods.description: Retrieves supervisor recipients for a given employee.

methods.name: getLeaveDetailsByDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Generates leave details summaries from detailed leave objects.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestComments
methods.description: Fetches comments associated with a specific leave request ID.
